title: ParetoPick-R
description: ParetoPick-R has been developed for post-processing multi-objective optimisation outputs. It facilitates the detailed analysis of Pareto fronts and supports decision making. It provides a dashboard for the user to supply their own data, visualise and explore it, produce maps, alter a range of parameters and perform clustering and an Analytical Hierarchy Process.
